veranderings.rede: Two coordinate adjectives (groot en plat) take a comma between them under the AWS.

veranderings.voor: Kyk laastens waarheen jou oog eerste gaan. Sê dan wat
veranderings.na: Kyk daarna waarheen jou oog eerste gaan. Sê laastens wat
veranderings.rede: A further step follows 'laastens', so the sequence marker belongs on the real last step; the steps and their order are unchanged.

veranderings.na: aan hul vel en hare smeer
veranderings.rede: Without the possessive the phrase sounds clipped; 'aan hul vel en hare' also matches the study text.
